description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.tldr: You can cast spells using Charisma as your spellcasting ability, shaping magic through music and oratory.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d6)
features.tldr: You can inspire others through words or music, granting a d6 bonus die to add to d20 rolls.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.tldr: Add half your proficiency bonus to any ability check you make that doesn't already include your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Song of Rest (d6)
features.tldr: Use soothing music or oratory to help wounded allies regain extra hit points during a short rest.

features.name: Bard College
features.tldr: Choose a college that shapes your magical performance style and grants specialized features.

features.name: Expertise
features.tldr: Choose two of your skill proficiencies to double your proficiency bonus for checks made with them.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d8)
features.tldr: Your Bardic Inspiration die increases to a d8.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.tldr: You now regain all expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a short or long rest.

features.name: Countercharm
features.tldr: Use musical notes or words of power to grant advantage on saving throws against being frightened or charmed for you and allies.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.tldr: Increase one ability score by 2, or two different scores by 1 (or select a feat).

features.name: Song of Rest (d8)
features.tldr: The extra healing provided by your Song of Rest increases to a d8.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration (d10)
features.tldr: Your Bardic Inspiration die increases to a d10.

features.name: Expertise
features.tldr: Choose two more skill proficiencies to double your proficiency bonus for checks made with them.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.tldr: Learn two spells of your choice from any class's spell list.
